title: Persist the local Announce origin sequence across Node restarts
description: P1 correctness/protocol: Node constructs AnnounceScheduler with _seq_num=0 on every startup and never calls set_seq_num() or set_on_seq_change(), even when persist_path and a rollback anchor are configured. Receivers now durably restore 16-bit Announce replay floors, so a restarted origin emits sequence 1 and can be rejected for up to half the sequence space; for floors in the opposite half of the ring, the reset value can instead be misclassified as newer. Integrate crash-safe sender-sequence reservation/restoration with Node persistence, define wrap/restart behavior, and add two-Node reboot tests around low, high, and wrap boundary floors.
